commands:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "42ab06f5d545d261814a52bd2fb923e7fc83f847"
printf '%s\n' '=== requirements ==='
cat backend/requirements.txt
printf '%s\n' '=== references ==='
rg -n --hidden --glob '!frontend/node_modules/**' --glob '!.git/**' 'requirements(\-dev|\-runtime)?\.txt|pip install .*requirements' . || true
printf '%s\n' '=== python imports for candidate dev packages ==='
for name in pytest httpx ruff coverage schemathesis; do echo "--- $name"; rg -n --glob '*.py' "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])${name}([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)" backend scripts tools || true; done
printf '%s\n' '=== workflows ==='
sed -n '1,220p' .github/workflows/ci.yml
sed -n '1,260p' .github/workflows/sandbox-pack.yml
printf '%s\n' '=== bootstrap ==='
sed -n '1,260p' tools/sandbox/bootstrap-sandbox.sh
printf '%s\n' '=== docs refs ==='
rg -n 'requirements\.txt' README.md docs backend scripts tools .github || true
